name: What are the long-term consequences of ignoring uneven flooring?

mainEntity.name: What are the long-term consequences of ignoring uneven flooring?

acceptedAnswer.text: Ignoring uneven flooring can lead to a range of escalating problems. Beyond being a tripping hazard, it can cause structural stress on the building, potentially leading to cracks in walls, ceilings, and foundations over time. Doors and windows may become difficult to open or close, and plumbing lines could be stressed. Additionally, it can damage new flooring materials installed over the uneven surface, reducing their lifespan and aesthetic appeal. Addressing the issue promptly can prevent more extensive and costly repairs in the future.
acceptedAnswer.description: Ignoring uneven flooring can lead to tripping hazards, structural stress, wall/ceiling cracks, door/window issues, and damage to new flooring. Prompt repair prevents costlier issues.
